network_enforcement: The checker makes no network request. Its Lean replay invokes the existing target validation shell, which compiles fresh local modules with Lean --trust=0 inside Bubblewrap --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and a disposable writable output directory. The pinned shared warm .lake closure is reused read-only, so this remains nonrelease worker evidence rather than a cold hermetic release run.
scope_boundary: Reconciles the current structured target, frozen graph, proof receipt, validation receipt, and a fresh narrow exact-root replay into a truthful negative release decision. It cannot supply dependency acceptance, authoritative graph/provenance reconciliation, H0/R0 review, accepted foundation/TCB/SBOM closure, immutable clean input, cold offline restoration, a second independent attestation, a minimal independent verifier, a deterministic bundle, or master acceptance.
